result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I raised no new findings, and both fixes assigned to me are verified and closed as `CLOSED_VERIFIED`.

**Candidate:** HEAD is `2cfbf4f`, and the recomputed candidate ID matches `sha256:d3743a35…49ab7`. Between the freeze commit `a6bdea0` and HEAD, only excluded metadata changed. Since round 6, only three candidate files changed: `architecture.testkit.ts`, `architecture.test.ts` and `decisions.md`. I ran everything in a full disposable clone, which I have since deleted.

**Fixes verified**
- **F-DG1-127 (Low, node:sqlite loader route):**
  - My independent probe passes 16/16: all 11 ways of importing sqlite are reported, the process and vm imports are still caught, and the clean control stays clean.
  - Negative control: with the pre-fix testkit, exactly A1 fails (77 of 78 pass).
  - A real `node:sqlite` import planted in the module tree turns the check red. With it removed, the check is back to 78/78.
  - The change only touches test files. Unit, integration and e2e results are unchanged.
- **F-DG1-212 (Low, installer log):**
  - The cited log shows the 14-case suite (AC-1 to AC-10): 14 passed, 0 failed, exit 0.
  - Its labels match the frozen suite's labels exactly.
  - It was regenerated after the installer fix (3037ce2), and `tools/deps` has not changed since.
  - My own run of the suite: 13 of 14 cases pass, including AC-10. AC-1 (effect) is BLOCKED because this sandbox has no package registry (connection refused). An offline version of AC-1 (effect) passes.

**Checks run**

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint, format, no-CDN, contrast | PASS |
| OpenAPI lint | PASS, 33 operations |
| Unit | 271/271 (architecture 78/78) |
| Integration, run twice | 200/200 both times, no 57P01 in either PostgreSQL log (F-DG1-009 holds) |
| Migrations | 0001–0008 applied |
| Audit trigger | UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE rejected |
| Contract | 9/9, including getBrandingTokens |
| e2e, English and Arabic | 22/22, including F-DG1-210 |
| My independent F-DG1-210 test | 2/2 |
| A12, A13, A14 | green (in the integration runs) |
| A18 clean start, A20 token propagation | PASS |
| Validator (`--register DG1`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile`) | PASS |

All 12 assigned requirements are marked IMPLEMENTED in the register, and all their cited evidence exists.

**BLOCKED (no registry network in this sandbox; none counted as PASS)**
- The whole installer-suite run, which exits 1 here only because of AC-1 (effect).
- The live-registry AC-1 (effect) case.
- `pnpm deps:verify`, which is not assigned.

**Observations (no severity, not findings)**
- The A1 self-check title still says "(round-4 lint: 'missed')", carried over from the test template. This is cosmetic.
- The notes cell of the REQ-DLV-042 register row still has the old analyst remark "acceptance suite 7/7". It is a dated note, not the cited evidence.

**Limits on these checks**
- I checked the review record against the schema field by field rather than with a full JSON Schema validator.
- Other round-7 reviewer files existed during my run. I did not read them.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-7/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-7/`. The new probe is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r7-sqlite-import-probe.test.ts`.
